requirements.summary: Screen/buttons/Wi-Fi terminal and printer are external boundaries; the server owns authoritative records and validation.
QRWTY and inventory are separate application profiles sharing transport/driver mechanisms, not a combined domain server requirement.
requirements.remainingWork: Implement versioned profile compatibility, allowed actions, label templates and explicit server binding independently; no profile DSL/editor is supplied.

requirements.summary: Product/SKU, individual item, label version, print job, inventory event and location are distinct; printed snapshots do not update with records.

requirements.summary: Lookup or printing alone must not change stock; stock changes require explicit supported workflow context and separate print outcomes.
requirements.remainingWork: Define supported actions before implementing stock transitions; do not invent receive/move/retire requirements from the examples.
